_comment: Hand-written zh-TW text for the site. If you change a tagline or summary in plugins.content.json, update its text and translatedFrom here, or GEN --check fails. Keep each text on one line.

tagline.text: 以評測驅動改進，並提供驅動它的 harness
tagline.translatedFrom: Eval-driven improvement, plus the harness to drive it

summary.text: 外掛由兩個部分組成一個循環。核心是「編輯 → 評測 → 保留或捨棄」引擎。引擎可以改進程式碼、提示詞或文件。引擎用 shell 指令、LLM 評審或兩者，為每次修改評分。進度顯示在即時的 Artifact 儀表板上。Harness 建構器從六個類別衡量專案健康度。建構器會建立回饋循環、評測、感測器，以及管理脈絡的建議。然後，建構器用同一個循環修正排名最高的問題。
summary.translatedFrom: Two parts form one loop. An edit → eval → keep/discard engine improves code, prompts, or docs. It scores each change with a shell command, an LLM judge, or both. It shows progress in a live Artifact dashboard. A harness builder measures project health in six categories. It creates feedback loops, evals, sensors, and context management advisories. It then fixes the top-ranked issue through the same loop.

tagline.text: 多代理 PR 審查，加上各 repo 自己的審查政策
tagline.translatedFrom: Multi-agent PR review with a per-repo policy layer

summary.text: 外掛在 PR 上平行執行五個審查員。五個審查員負責正確性、測試、安全、維運與簡潔度。簡潔度審查採用 ponytail 與 /simplify 規則。如果 repo 有本地審查政策，第六個審查員會引用它。政策記錄該 repo 自己的警訊、陷阱與熱點。`refresh-policy` 從已合併的 git 與 PR 歷史學習這份政策。
summary.translatedFrom: Runs five reviewers in parallel on a PR: correctness, tests, security, ops, and simplicity (ponytail and /simplify rules). If the repo has a local review policy, a sixth reviewer cites the repo's own red-flags, pitfalls, and hotspots. Includes `refresh-policy`, which learns that policy from merged git and PR history.

tagline.text: 讓文字像真人寫的，支援 zh-TW 與英文
tagline.translatedFrom: Sound like a person, in zh-TW or English

summary.text: 外掛包含兩個 skill。distill 從寫作範例擷取你的語氣。distill 把語氣存成可重複使用的預設。rewrite 移除既有文字中的 AI 痕跡。適用的文字包括 PR 留言、貼文與電子郵件。rewrite 會配合指定語氣，保留原意，並且絕不捏造事實。繁體中文與英文各有一套規則，外掛會自動偵測語言。另有一個只標記、不修改的稽核模式。
summary.translatedFrom: Two skills. distill captures your voice from writing samples into a reusable tone preset; rewrite strips AI-tells from existing text (PR comments, posts, emails) and matches a tone, preserving meaning and never inventing facts. Separate Traditional-Chinese and English rulesets, auto-detected, plus a flag-only audit mode.

tagline.text: 回覆先講行動，阻礙排在參考資訊之前

summary.text: 一套規則，分成三層。第 1 層調整每一則回覆。回覆先寫行動，多步驟工作加上編號與時間估計。回覆刪除開場白、重述與結尾，錯誤只陳述事實。第 2 層管理大型多步驟工作的最後一則回覆。這則回覆使用 Review-Ready 分類：✅ Done / ⚠️ Broken / 🙋 What I need from you / 🤖 What I'll do。阻礙排在參考資訊之前，每個請求都說明為何由你決定。視覺層把非線性的流程概念畫成 ASCII 圖，取代文字說明。圖放在程式碼區塊中。這類概念包括分支、迴圈、狀態變化與階層。線性步驟仍然用編號清單。規則只套用在面向使用者的主對話。預設開啟的 SessionStart hook 會把規則注入主工作階段。因此，子代理的回傳仍然保留完整細節。外掛預設開啟，安裝後主對話立即套用規則。如果要關閉某個工作階段，請設定 CLAUDE_ADHD_REVIEW=0。用 /adhd-review-mode 可以切換單一工作階段。
summary.translatedFrom: One ruleset, three layers. Layer 1 shapes every reply — lead with the action, number multi-step work with time estimates, cut preamble/recap/closers, state errors matter-of-factly. Layer 2 governs the final turn of substantial multi-step work with Review-Ready buckets — ✅ Done / ⚠️ Broken / 🙋 What I need from you / 🤖 What I'll do, blockers before FYI, each ask naming why it's yours. A Visual Layer draws non-linear flow-shaped concepts — branches, loops, state changes, hierarchies — as fenced ASCII diagrams instead of prose, while linear steps stay numbered lists. Applies to the human-facing thread only: a default-on SessionStart hook injects the rules into the main session, so subagent returns stay full-detail. On by default — installing the plugin shapes the main thread out of the box; set CLAUDE_ADHD_REVIEW=0 to silence a session. Toggle per session with /adhd-review-mode.

summary.text: receipts 是一個 Stop hook，要求每個主張都能證明。回合結束時，如果回覆宣稱 **FACT:** 或完成，receipts 會檢查它。完成的說法包括 'verified'、'tests pass'、'fixed'、'done'。免費的確定性預篩先用該回合真實的工具呼叫比對主張。只有真正模糊的主張，才交給全新脈絡的 Haiku 評審。沒有證據的主張會加上 ⚠ 註記，這是預設的 `warn` 模式。`block` 模式會擋下該回合。Claude 必須用真實的工具呼叫證明每個主張，或把它降級為 **ASSUME:**。每個主張在每個工作階段只挑戰一次，由 ledger 與 stop_hook_active 做後援。外掛落實 fact-assume 原則：FACT 必須在受到質疑時可以證明。RLHF 帶來的自信「done」會悄悄侵蝕這個原則。外掛預設開啟，出錯時放行（fail-open）。設定 CLAUDE_RECEIPTS=0 可以停用。/receipts 會列出工作階段的稽核 ledger，並設定模式。
summary.translatedFrom: A Stop hook that enforces provable claims. When the finished turn asserts a **FACT:** or a completion ('verified', 'tests pass', 'fixed', 'done'), a free deterministic prefilter checks it against that turn's real tool calls; only genuinely ambiguous claims escalate to a fresh-context Haiku judge. Unbacked claims are flagged with a ⚠ note (default `warn` mode) — or hard-gate the turn in `block` mode, where Claude must prove each with a real tool call or downgrade it to **ASSUME:** — bounded to one challenge per claim per session (ledger + stop_hook_active backstop). Enforces the fact-assume discipline (FACT = provable if challenged) that RLHF's confident 'done' quietly erodes. On by default and fail-open; set CLAUDE_RECEIPTS=0 to disable. /receipts prints the session's audit ledger and sets the mode.

tagline.text: 一個外掛管好筆記庫：繪圖、格式、標籤
tagline.translatedFrom: One plugin for the vault: draw, format, tag

summary.text: create-excali 與 update-excali 用 ExcalidrawAutomate 建立 Excalidraw 圖。這兩個 skill 會檢查幾何，並審查實際輸出的 PNG。format-note 依筆記類型撰寫與檢查筆記。筆記類型包括 map、concept、takeaway、literature 與 fleeting。format-note 保留舊 visualize skill 的 ASCII 圖與 callout 規則。migrate-notes 為整個筆記庫設定筆記類型，並重新命名 map 筆記。這些變更合成一份計畫，核准後才執行。audit-tags 找出錯誤、重複、錯字與不在分類表中的標籤。它套用一份核准過的重新命名計畫，並先建立備份。handover-new、handover-wrap-up、handover-init-org 與 handover-init-service 建立並收尾交接文件。交接文件存放在筆記庫中。session-wrap-up、session-pick-up 與 session-recommend 把工作階段整理成反思重點。核准一次後，它們會在筆記庫中建立 Zettelkasten 卡片。一個專用 skill 在筆記庫中撰寫與檢查受控繁體中文。SessionStart hook 引導 Claude 以 obsidian CLI 為準。筆記庫的偏好設定存放在筆記庫檔案 .obsidian-kit.json 中。外掛不依賴其他外掛。
summary.translatedFrom: create-excali and update-excali build Excalidraw drawings through ExcalidrawAutomate, lint the geometry, and review the real PNG render. format-note writes and checks notes by their note-type (map, concept, takeaway, literature, fleeting) and keeps the ASCII-diagram and callout rules of the old visualize skill. migrate-notes sets note-type across a vault and renames map notes, as one approved plan. audit-tags finds false, duplicate, typo, and off-taxonomy tags and applies one approved rename plan with backups. handover-new, handover-wrap-up, handover-init-org, and handover-init-service create and wrap up handover documents backed by the vault. session-wrap-up, session-pick-up, and session-recommend turn a working session into reflection take-aways and, after one approval, Zettelkasten cards in the vault. A dedicated skill writes and checks controlled Traditional Chinese inside the vault. A SessionStart hook primes Claude to treat the obsidian CLI as the source of truth. Vault opinions live in the vault file .obsidian-kit.json. No cross-plugin deps.
